about_the_game:
Sleeper S9 – Demo is a short horror experience set in the eerie corridors of an Indian sleeper train. You boarded late, jumping into coach S0 of a moving train, but your seat is in coach S9—and the path there is anything but normal. Strange anomalies begin to haunt the coaches, challenging your perception and testing your resolve. In this demo, you’ll journey through coaches S0 to S4, navigating dark, narrow compartments while reacting to subtle, reality-bending disturbances. The rule is simple: if you see something strange, move forward—if not, turn back. But remember, nothing on this train stays normal for long. Face the unknown, survive the anomalies, and experience the chilling first leg of the Sleeper S9 horror journey.


Key Features

🔹 Short Horror Experience: Shorter and introductory experience to the full version of this game. 

🔹 Console to view mistakes/ anomalies: View your mistakes in 'console' -which can be found on the bottom right of the settings menu at S0. Press F1 and see the anomalies in the current level.

🔹 Anomaly-Based Horror: Stay alert for subtle and terrifying disturbances in the environment.
🔹 Atmospheric Experience: Immersive visuals and sound design inspired by real Indian sleeper trains.
🔹 Decision-Driven Exploration: Your ability to perceive anomalies determines your survival.

🔹 Jump Scares – Sudden frights crafted to keep you on edge.

🔹 Visual Customization – Customize how the game looks

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Traverse the sleeper coaches of an apparent empty Indian train—or so it seems. If you see an anomaly, face it and move forward. If not, it may be a trick of the mind—return to the previous coach. But beware, some anomalies will do everything to stop you. Face them or be lost forever.
